pre_meeting:acme.subject: Ahead of tomorrow's Q4 business review
pre_meeting:acme.body:
Hi Rohan,

Ahead of tomorrow's review, I want to be upfront: the export issues since v2.4 (large exports timing out and scheduled exports failing silently) are our top priority, and I know they are blocking your month-end close.

We also missed the scheduled exports date we committed to at the Q3 review. Tomorrow I will bring a fix date we can stand behind and a plan for the finance onboarding session that is still open.

If there is anything else you want on the agenda, reply here and I will add it.

Best,
Maya

customer_update:acme.subject: Update on the export issues
customer_update:acme.body:
Hi Rohan,

A quick update on the export problems your team has reported since v2.4: we have reproduced the large-export timeouts and the silent scheduled-export failures, and engineering is working on the fix now.

I will send you a firm date as soon as the fix is scheduled, and I will check in with Priya on how finance is handling month-end in the meantime.

Best,
Maya
